parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The tags for the virtual node.

parameters.name: ClusterDNS
parameters.description: A client token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ClusterDomain
parameters.description:
The IP address of the DNS server. If the dnsPolicy of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) pod is set to `ClusterFirst`, the pod uses this IP address for the DNS service.
You can specify multiple IP addresses. Use commas (,) to separate the IP addresses.

parameters.name: CustomResources
parameters.description: The domain name of the cluster. Kubelet configures all containers to search for this domain name in addition to the search domain of the host.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the virtual node.

parameters.name: VirtualNodeId
parameters.description: The name of the virtual node.

parameters.name: VirtualNodeName
parameters.description:
The custom resources that the virtual node supports. If an ECI pod requests the custom resources, the pod is scheduled to the virtual node.
The value must be in the `resource_name=resource_count` format. Use commas (,) to separate multiple resources.
